lessons.name: The Art of Conversation
lessons.description: Paronyms: words that look alike but mean different things.

multiple_choice.name: Match the paronyms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to the right Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: An economical car
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Новата кола е много __ – харчи само четири литра на сто километра.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Новата кола е много икономична..." means "The new car is very economical..." Икономически describes the economy itself, as in икономическа криза.

true_false.name: True or false: Efekten
true_false.sentence: "Ефектен" and "ефективен" are synonyms.
true_false.explanation: "Ефектен" means striking or showy, and "ефективен" means effective.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Striking but useless
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Презентацията беше __ и впечатли всички, но не беше особено полезна.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Презентацията беше ефектна..." means "The presentation was striking and impressed everyone, but was not very useful." An effective one would have been useful.

true_false.name: True or false: Abonat
true_false.sentence: "Абонат" is the subscriber, and "абонамент" is the subscription.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The two are often mixed up, even by native speakers.

multiple_choice.name: Match more paronyms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to the right Bulgarian word.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A humane attitude
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Отношението на лекаря към пациентите беше изключително __ и топло.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...беше изключително човечно и топло" means "...was exceptionally humane and warm." Човешки means "of humans", човечен means "kind".

lessons.name: Voices of Literature
lessons.description: Archaic and folk-poetic words, and the rules of the full article and "ѝ".

multiple_choice.name: Match archaic and modern
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each archaic or folk-poetic word with its everyday equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The author is a poet
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ на книгата е известен поет.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Авторът на книгата е известен поет." means "The author of the book is a famous poet." The subject takes the full article -ът.

true_false.name: True or false: Full article
true_false.sentence: In standard Bulgarian the full article marks a masculine subject: "Авторът пише", but "Видях автора".
true_false.explanation: Correct. As a rule of thumb, the full article -ът/-ят goes on the subject and the short -а/-я on everything else.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I gave her a book
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Подарих __ книга за рождения ден.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Подарих ѝ книга за рождения ден." means "I gave her a book for her birthday." The pronoun "to her" is written ѝ, with a grave accent.

true_false.name: True or false: Writing i
true_false.sentence: The pronoun "ѝ" (to her) may be written as plain "и", because context makes it clear.
true_false.explanation: The standard requires ѝ, which keeps the pronoun apart from the conjunction и (and).

multiple_choice.name: Match the literary terms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: With his sister
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той говори __ сестра си всяка вечер.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той говори със сестра си всяка вечер." means "He talks to his sister every evening." Before a word starting with с or з, the preposition с becomes със.

lessons.name: Kinship in Detail
lessons.description: The full range of in-law terms Bulgarian keeps apart.

multiple_choice.name: Match the in-laws
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each relationship to its Bulgarian term.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My husband's sister
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Утре идва на гости моята __ – сестрата на мъжа ми.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Утре идва на гости моята зълва..." means "My sister-in-law, my husband's sister, is visiting tomorrow."

true_false.name: True or false: Etarva
true_false.sentence: "Етърва" is what two women married to brothers are to each other.
true_false.explanation: Correct. The husband's brother's wife is your етърва.

fill_in_the_blank.name: My sister's husband
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Мъжът на сестра ми, моят __ Петър, е лекар.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Мъжът на сестра ми, моят зет Петър, е лекар." means "My sister's husband, my brother-in-law Petar, is a doctor." Зет also means son-in-law.

true_false.name: True or false: Shurey
true_false.sentence: "Шурей" is the husband's brother.
true_false.explanation: A шурей is the wife's brother. The husband's brother is a девер.

multiple_choice.name: Match more in-laws
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each relationship to its Bulgarian term.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The best man signed
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На сватбата __ и кумата подписаха като свидетели.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На сватбата кумът и кумата подписаха като свидетели." means "At the wedding the best man and the matron of honour signed as witnesses." The subject takes the full article.

lessons.name: Numbers and Precision
lessons.description: Numerals for people, count forms and approximate numbers.

multiple_choice.name: Match the counted phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Three colleagues
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: На срещата дойдоха __ колеги.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "На срещата дойдоха трима колеги." means "Three colleagues came to the meeting." Male or mixed groups of people are counted with двама, трима, четирима.

true_false.name: True or false: Count form
true_false.sentence: After a number, masculine nouns for things take the count form: "два стола", not "два столове".
true_false.explanation: Correct. The count form ends in -а/-я: два стола, три града.

fill_in_the_blank.name: About fifty people
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Събраха се __ души.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Събраха се петдесетина души." means "About fifty people gathered." The suffix -ина makes a number approximate, so adding "около" would say it twice.

true_false.name: True or false: Dvama zheni
true_false.sentence: "Двама жени" is correct when counting women.
true_false.explanation: Двама is only for men or mixed groups. For women, say "две жени".

multiple_choice.name: Match the fractions
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: All three children
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: И __ деца учат в чужбина.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "И трите деца учат в чужбина." means "All three children study abroad." Деца is neuter, so it takes трите; тримата is only for men or mixed groups.

lessons.name: Property and the Law
lessons.description: The notarial and legal vocabulary of owning a home.

multiple_choice.name: Match the property law terms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Free of encumbrances
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Имотът е __ от всякакви тежести.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Имотът е свободен от всякакви тежести." means "The property is free of all encumbrances."

true_false.name: True or false: Servitut
true_false.sentence: A "сервитут" is a right to use part of someone else's property, for example to cross their land.
true_false.explanation: Correct. A right of way (право на преминаване) is the most common kind.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The seller undertakes
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Продавачът се __ да прехвърли собствеността в срок от 30 дни.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Продавачът се задължава да прехвърли собствеността..." means "The seller undertakes to transfer ownership within 30 days." Contracts use the present imperfective for obligations.

true_false.name: True or false: Sasobstvenost
true_false.sentence: "Съсобственост" means that the property belongs to the state.
true_false.explanation: It means the property is owned jointly by several people.

multiple_choice.name: Match the property rights
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A power of attorney
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Дадох на брат си нотариално заверено __ да продаде апартамента от мое име.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "...нотариално заверено пълномощно да продаде апартамента от мое име" means "...a notarised power of attorney to sell the flat on my behalf."

lessons.name: Toasts and Wishes
lessons.description: Wishes for every occasion, with "да", "нека" and "дано".

multiple_choice.name: Match the wishes
pairs: Wishing you long life and health
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English meaning to the Bulgarian wish.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Let your dreams come true
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вдигам тост и __ се сбъднат всичките ви мечти!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вдигам тост и нека се сбъднат всичките ви мечти!" means "I raise a toast, and may all your dreams come true!"

true_false.name: True or false: Bog da go prosti
true_false.sentence: "Бог да го прости" is said when speaking of someone who has died.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It means "May God forgive him" and is used much like "may he rest in peace".

fill_in_the_blank.name: Get well soon
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Дано __ скоро, липсваш ни в офиса!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Дано оздравееш скоро, липсваш ни в офиса!" means "I hope you get well soon, we miss you at the office!" Липсваш shows the wish is for "ти".

true_false.name: True or false: Za mnogo godini
true_false.sentence: "За много години" is only said at funerals.
true_false.explanation: It is said on birthdays and name days, meaning "for many years to come".

multiple_choice.name: Match the wedding words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Live long and healthy
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Да сте живи и __ и да се обичате!
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Да сте живи и здрави и да се обичате!" means "Wishing you long life and health, and may you love each other!" "Сте" is plural, so the adjective is too.

lessons.name: Legal and Administrative Language
lessons.description: The fixed phrases of contracts and official documents.

multiple_choice.name: Match the legal phrases
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English phrase to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Pursuant to article 5
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: __ чл. 5 от договора наемателят заплаща консумативите.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Съгласно чл. 5 от договора наемателят заплаща консумативите." means "Pursuant to article 5 of the contract, the tenant pays the utilities."

true_false.name: True or false: V sluchai che
true_false.sentence: "В случай че" is written without a comma between "случай" and "че".
true_false.explanation: Correct. "В случай че" is one conjunction, so no comma goes inside it.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Indefinite term
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Договорът се сключва за __ срок.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Договорът се сключва за неопределен срок." means "The contract is concluded for an indefinite term."

true_false.name: True or false: Nishtozhen
true_false.sentence: A "нищожен договор" is a contract of very small value.
true_false.explanation: In law, нищожен means void: the contract has no legal effect.

multiple_choice.name: Match the court terms
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Subject to appeal
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Решението подлежи на __ в 14-дневен срок.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Решението подлежи на обжалване в 14-дневен срок." means "The ruling may be appealed within 14 days." Подлежи на takes a noun.

lessons.name: Philosophy and Ideas
lessons.description: Abstract vocabulary, compound words and the prepositions that go with them.

multiple_choice.name: Match the abstract words
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English term to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Indifferent to opinion
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Той е безразличен __ чуждото мнение.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Той е безразличен към чуждото мнение." means "He is indifferent to other people's opinion." Безразличен takes към.

true_false.name: True or false: Mirogled
true_false.sentence: "Мироглед" is built from "мир" (world) and "глед" (view).
true_false.explanation: Correct. It is a compound, just like the German Weltanschauung.

fill_in_the_blank.name: The theory rests on
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Теорията почива __ няколко недоказани допускания.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Теорията почива върху няколко недоказани допускания." means "The theory rests on several unproven assumptions."

true_false.name: True or false: Samosaznanie
true_false.sentence: "Самосъзнание" and "съзнание" mean exactly the same thing.
true_false.explanation: "Съзнание" is consciousness, and "самосъзнание" is awareness of oneself.

multiple_choice.name: Match the big ideas
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English word to its Bulgarian equivalent.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Responsible for decisions
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Човек носи отговорност __ собствените си решения.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Човек носи отговорност за собствените си решения." means "A person is responsible for their own decisions." Отговорност за is for what you answer for; отговорност към is for whom.

lessons.name: Time in Language
lessons.description: The names of the Bulgarian tenses and the fine points of counterfactuals.

multiple_choice.name: Match the tense names
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English tense name to its Bulgarian term.

fill_in_the_blank.name: If I had known your number
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Щях да ти се обадя, ако __ номера ти.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Щях да ти се обадя, ако знаех номера ти." means "I would have called you if I had known your number."

true_false.name: True or false: Da beshe doshal
true_false.sentence: In "Да беше дошъл по-рано!", "да" with a past form expresses regret or an unreal wish.
true_false.explanation: Correct. It means "If only you had come earlier!"

fill_in_the_blank.name: The film will have started
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Когато стигнем, филмът вече ще е __ отдавна.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Когато стигнем, филмът вече ще е започнал отдавна." means "By the time we arrive, the film will have started long ago." This is the future perfect.

true_false.name: True or false: Future perfect
true_false.sentence: Bulgarian has no future perfect tense.
true_false.explanation: It does: the бъдеще предварително време, as in "ще съм започнал".

multiple_choice.name: Match the other tense names
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each English name to its Bulgarian term.

fill_in_the_blank.name: I would have seen
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Ако не бях закъснял, __ да видя началото на филма.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Ако не бях закъснял, щях да видя началото на филма." means "If I had not been late, I would have seen the start of the film."

lessons.name: Folklore and National Memory
lessons.description: Classic writers, and proverbs every Bulgarian knows.

multiple_choice.name: Match writers and works
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each writer with one of their best-known works.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Drop by drop
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Капка по капка __ става.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Капка по капка вир става." means "Drop by drop a pool forms", so small efforts add up.

true_false.name: True or false: Pod igoto
true_false.sentence: "Под игото" is a novel about the April Uprising of 1876.
true_false.explanation: Correct. Ivan Vazov's novel is set in the town of Byala Cherkva before and during the uprising.

fill_in_the_blank.name: Whoever digs a pit
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Който другиму __ копае, сам пада в нея.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Който другиму яма копае, сам пада в нея." means "Whoever digs a pit for another falls into it himself." The feminine "в нея" points back to яма.

true_false.name: True or false: Barzata rabota
true_false.sentence: The proverb "Бързата работа – срам за майстора" praises doing things quickly.
true_false.explanation: It warns against haste: rushed work shames the craftsman.

multiple_choice.name: Match more writers
pairs: Да се завърнеш в бащината къща
multiple_choice.explanation: Match each writer with one of their best-known works.

fill_in_the_blank.name: A wolf changes its coat
fill_in_the_blank.sentence: Вълкът козината си мени, __ нрава си – не.
fill_in_the_blank.explanation: "Вълкът козината си мени, но нрава си – не." means "A wolf changes its coat but not its nature": people do not really change.
